identity.old_checkout_kind: immutable source archive; no Git commands used
identity.current_checkout_kind: clean detached Git worktree sharing the preserved54a checkout object store

methodology: Physical headers are not equivalent to installed public APIs; registration records distinguish installed public versus private/unregistered files.
Registration is a static union of selectable CMake branches, not a configured profile. No CMake/build/test execution was performed.
Generated configuration/export headers and third-party/contrib code are excluded; core source-side private headers are inventoried separately.
OpenSwath physical lists include unregistered stubs; registration identifies the actual target union.
No class-level parity percentage can be inferred from file or line counts.

Historical archive lacks top-level registration entrypoints, so only physical counts are compared across versions. The current registration union follows includes.cmake and all conditional sources; it is not a configured-profile or binary acceptance result.

The82ce update adds a shared private numeric formatter under src/common/include, outside the comparable scientific inventory roots. It is explicitly hashed and reviewed in tests/data/sdk_numeric_formatting_provenance.json and is not an installed public SDK header.

carried_forward_references.review: Removes noexcept from the existing checked index conversion; native indexing uses checked Rust values and does not expose this low-level converter. No peptide-matching result changes.
Explicitly initializes three previously value-initialized empty residue-override maps. All pKa values and arithmetic remain unchanged.

Adds extended-long-double libc++ formatting and removes equivalent redundant branches. Native f32/f64 formatting rules are unchanged; extended long double remains outside the native value surface. The 54a232f-to-82ce5b3 update moves appendNumeric into the shared private NumericFormatting.h and qualifies the six callers. The complete function body is identical after indentation normalization; native f32/f64 formatting rules and parsing are unchanged. The earlier extended-long-double boundary remains outside the native API.
Changes four null-pointer comparisons from 0 to nullptr; scientific assertions and fixtures are unchanged.
Adds valid-boundary and invalid-index conversion checks for the noexcept fix. Existing peptide matching assertions remain unchanged; the native low-level class is not claimed complete.
Uses logical conjunction instead of bitwise conjunction for two boolean values without side effects; expected peptide matches are unchanged.
Changes the constructor null-pointer comparison from 0 to nullptr; fitting assertions are unchanged.

reference_policy: Historical fixture revisions and hashes remain unchanged. Carried references use target hashes; changed source bytes record original hashes and explicit behavior reviews. Current-source manifests separately record target_verification. External Boost headers are outside this SDK comparison.
